name: Entity Webhook Polling
description: Submodule of Entity Webhook. Polls external APIs on a cron schedule (via dragonmantank/cron-expression) and feeds the results into the parent module's inbound webhook pipeline. Each polling configuration references an existing Webhook Endpoint and Source Type, runs a pluggable polling provider when its cron expression is due, and uses SHA-256 hashing to queue only new or changed records.
project_description: Entity Webhook Polling is the scheduled-ingestion submodule of Entity Webhook. Instead of waiting for an external service to POST a webhook, it pulls data from external APIs on a cron schedule and feeds the results through the same processing pipeline as inbound webhooks. Each polling configuration is a config entity that references an existing Webhook Endpoint and Source Type, carries a cron expression, and names a polling provider plugin. On every Drupal cron run the module loads all enabled configurations, uses dragonmantank/cron-expression to determine which are due, instantiates each due provider, and calls its fetch() method to retrieve an array of payloads. Each payload is hashed with SHA-256 and compared against the stored hash for its external ID, so only new or changed records are queued for entity upsert; unchanged records are skipped. Polling providers are a plugin type, so custom API integrations can be added. Requires the entity_webhook parent module. Maintained by Travis Tomka (droath).
